key_insight: Exact certification reveals that some reported quantum code and circuit distances are overstated, changing reliability estimates and design choices.
engineering_relevance: Certified distances help engineers compare codes, optimize error-correction schedules, and retain defective hardware that still meets protection targets.
method: Express code and circuit distances as tropical partition functions.
Evaluate using rank-based dynamic programming and weight-bounded search, aided by reductions and relaxations.
Certify exact distances by matching proved lower bounds with explicit logical errors.
evidence_signal: The authors certify codes with up to 31,200 qubits and circuits with up to 800,000 fault mechanisms; an audit finds distance discrepancies in 10 of 26 papers.
watch_item: Schedule improvements can add overhead: restoring IBM two-gross circuit distance from 16 to 18 at one noisy cycle requires an extra timestep per cycle.
paper_title: Certifying quantum code and circuit distances at scale
